editorial.blurb: Chef Max's intimate omakase experience delivers pristine, high-quality sushi with genuine warmth and expertise that keeps guests returning again and again.
editorial.insiderTip: Book the lunch omakase for a full, exceptional feast in under an hour, or request the hand roll bar for a more relaxed date-night vibe — ask about their tamari soy sauce if you're gluten-free.
signatureDishes: Hand rolls (especially salmon skin and crab)
